description: This Swift source file provides logging infrastructure for the 'OpenClaw' application, including log level management, label parsing, and handlers for system and file logging. It defines enums for log levels and settings, helper functions for label manipulation, and custom log handler classes that integrate with Apple's os.Logger and a custom DiagnosticsFileLog.

classes.name: OpenClawOSLogHandler
classes.description: Custom log handler integrating Apple's os.Logger with application-specific metadata, supporting different log levels and metadata merging

classes.name: OpenClawFileLogHandler
classes.description: Custom log handler for writing logs to external files via DiagnosticsFileLog, with support for enriched metadata

methods.name: logLevel
methods.description: Retrieves the current log level setting from UserDefaults

methods.name: setLogLevel
methods.description: Sets the current log level in UserDefaults

methods.name: fileLoggingEnabled
methods.description: Checks whether file logging is enabled based on UserDefaults

methods.name: parseLabel
methods.description: Parses a label string into subsystem and category components

methods.name: makeLabel
methods.description: Creates a label string from subsystem and category
